ProjectName: Iowa E. coli - Bacteria and Nutrients
SampleCollectionMethod/MethodName: Sample Collection for Ambient Water Monitoring
SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Water - Water samples are collected in the appropriate containers defined by thesample type.  These could be 1 L cubi-containers or plastic bottles, TOC vials, amber vials or bottles for organic parameters, plastic bottles for chlorophyll or TNTP, or sterile bottles for bacteria samples.  Sediment - Sediment samples are collected with a metal spoon or scoop.  For composited samples, a pie plate is used to collect sediment from the entire stream reach.  The sample is mixed and placed in 8 oz glass jars.  Periphyton - Periphyton is collected using an aspirator from the flat surface of rocks or other items in the stream.  The aspirated sample is collected in a VOA vial and removed from light.  Benthic macroinvertebrates - macroinvertebrate samples are collected with a D-frame collecting net.  A total of five 60 second kick samples are taken at each monitoring site and composited into one sample.  The composite sample is put into labeled sample jars and preserved with ethanol.
ResultAnalyticalMethod/MethodName: 9223 B ~ Enzyme substrate assay for measuring total coliforms and E. coli (ONPG-MUG test or CPRG-MUG test)

OrganizationFormalName: EPA R7
ProjectName: Iowa E. coli - Bacteria and Nutrients
SampleCollectionMethod/MethodName: Sample Collection for Ambient Water Monitoring
SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Water - Water samples are collected in the appropriate containers defined by thesample type.  These could be 1 L cubi-containers or plastic bottles, TOC vials, amber vials or bottles for organic parameters, plastic bottles for chlorophyll or TNTP, or sterile bottles for bacteria samples.  Sediment - Sediment samples are collected with a metal spoon or scoop.  For composited samples, a pie plate is used to collect sediment from the entire stream reach.  The sample is mixed and placed in 8 oz glass jars.  Periphyton - Periphyton is collected using an aspirator from the flat surface of rocks or other items in the stream.  The aspirated sample is collected in a VOA vial and removed from light.  Benthic macroinvertebrates - macroinvertebrate samples are collected with a D-frame collecting net.  A total of five 60 second kick samples are taken at each monitoring site and composited into one sample.  The composite sample is put into labeled sample jars and preserved with ethanol.
ResultAnalyticalMethod/MethodName: 9223 B ~ Enzyme substrate assay for measuring total coliforms and E. coli (ONPG-MUG test or CPRG-MUG test)

SampleCollectionMethod/MethodName: Sample Collection for Ambient Water Monitoring
SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Water - Water samples are collected in the appropriate containers defined by thesample type.  These could be 1 L cubi-containers or plastic bottles, TOC vials, amber vials or bottles for organic parameters, plastic bottles for chlorophyll or TNTP, or sterile bottles for bacteria samples.  Sediment - Sediment samples are collected with a metal spoon or scoop.  For composited samples, a pie plate is used to collect sediment from the entire stream reach.  The sample is mixed and placed in 8 oz glass jars.  Periphyton - Periphyton is collected using an aspirator from the flat surface of rocks or other items in the stream.  The aspirated sample is collected in a VOA vial and removed from light.  Benthic macroinvertebrates - macroinvertebrate samples are collected with a D-frame collecting net.  A total of five 60 second kick samples are taken at each monitoring site and composited into one sample.  The composite sample is put into labeled sample jars and preserved with ethanol.
ResultAnalyticalMethod/MethodName: 9223 B ~ Enzyme substrate assay for measuring total coliforms and E. coli (ONPG-MUG test or CPRG-MUG test)

SampleCollectionMethod/MethodName: Sample Collection for Ambient Water Monitoring
SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Water - Water samples are collected in the appropriate containers defined by thesample type.  These could be 1 L cubi-containers or plastic bottles, TOC vials, amber vials or bottles for organic parameters, plastic bottles for chlorophyll or TNTP, or sterile bottles for bacteria samples.  Sediment - Sediment samples are collected with a metal spoon or scoop.  For composited samples, a pie plate is used to collect sediment from the entire stream reach.  The sample is mixed and placed in 8 oz glass jars.  Periphyton - Periphyton is collected using an aspirator from the flat surface of rocks or other items in the stream.  The aspirated sample is collected in a VOA vial and removed from light.  Benthic macroinvertebrates - macroinvertebrate samples are collected with a D-frame collecting net.  A total of five 60 second kick samples are taken at each monitoring site and composited into one sample.  The composite sample is put into labeled sample jars and preserved with ethanol.
ResultAnalyticalMethod/MethodName: 9223 B ~ Enzyme substrate assay for measuring total coliforms and E. coli (ONPG-MUG test or CPRG-MUG test)

ProjectName: Iowa E. coli - Bacteria and Nutrients
SampleCollectionMethod/MethodName: Sample Collection for Ambient Water Monitoring
SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Water - Water samples are collected in the appropriate containers defined by thesample type.  These could be 1 L cubi-containers or plastic bottles, TOC vials, amber vials or bottles for organic parameters, plastic bottles for chlorophyll or TNTP, or sterile bottles for bacteria samples.  Sediment - Sediment samples are collected with a metal spoon or scoop.  For composited samples, a pie plate is used to collect sediment from the entire stream reach.  The sample is mixed and placed in 8 oz glass jars.  Periphyton - Periphyton is collected using an aspirator from the flat surface of rocks or other items in the stream.  The aspirated sample is collected in a VOA vial and removed from light.  Benthic macroinvertebrates - macroinvertebrate samples are collected with a D-frame collecting net.  A total of five 60 second kick samples are taken at each monitoring site and composited into one sample.  The composite sample is put into labeled sample jars and preserved with ethanol.
ResultAnalyticalMethod/MethodName: 9223 B ~ Enzyme substrate assay for measuring total coliforms and E. coli (ONPG-MUG test or CPRG-MUG test)

These could be 1 L cubi-containers or plastic bottles, TOC vials, amber vials or bottles for organic parameters, plastic bottles for chlorophyll or TNTP, or sterile bottles for bacteria samples.  Sediment - Sediment samples are collected with a metal spoon or scoop.  For composited samples, a pie plate is used to collect sediment from the entire stream reach.  The sample is mixed and placed in 8 oz glass jars.  Periphyton - Periphyton is collected using an aspirator from the flat surface of rocks or other items in the stream.  The aspirated sample is collected in a VOA vial and removed from light.  Benthic macroinvertebrates - macroinvertebrate samples are collected with a D-frame collecting net.  A total of five 60 second kick samples are taken at each monitoring site and composited into one sample.  The composite sample is put into labeled sample jars and preserved with ethanol.
ResultAnalyticalMethod/MethodName: 9223 B ~ Enzyme substrate assay for measuring total coliforms and E. coli (ONPG-MUG test or CPRG-MUG test)

These could be 1 L cubi-containers or plastic bottles, TOC vials, amber vials or bottles for organic parameters, plastic bottles for chlorophyll or TNTP, or sterile bottles for bacteria samples.  Sediment - Sediment samples are collected with a metal spoon or scoop.  For composited samples, a pie plate is used to collect sediment from the entire stream reach.  The sample is mixed and placed in 8 oz glass jars.  Periphyton - Periphyton is collected using an aspirator from the flat surface of rocks or other items in the stream.  The aspirated sample is collected in a VOA vial and removed from light.  Benthic macroinvertebrates - macroinvertebrate samples are collected with a D-frame collecting net.  A total of five 60 second kick samples are taken at each monitoring site and composited into one sample.  The composite sample is put into labeled sample jars and preserved with ethanol.
ResultAnalyticalMethod/MethodName: 9223 B ~ Enzyme substrate assay for measuring total coliforms and E. coli (ONPG-MUG test or CPRG-MUG test)
